page.overview:
Who is Avimimus?

Return to Jurassic Park VI}} was a of theropod dinosaur that lived in the late Cretaceous in what is now Mongolia, around 70 million years ago. Avimimus was a small dinosaur with a length of 1.5 meters (5 feet). The skull was small compared to the body, though the brain and eyes were large.

Avimimus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.

Avimimus is no. 022 of the Carnivore Ones that can be created in Jurassic Park III: Park Builder.

A group of Avimimus that were genetically modified to possess plumage were created by Dr. Gustavus in a hidden lab in Jurassic Park. These animals were later discovered by InGen scientists Derrick Hoyle and Abby Nakajima, who had snuck into Gustavus' lab in order to find out what he was working on. Gustavus soon returned to his lab and, upon discovering the two, introduced them to some of his creations, including the Avimimus, before attempting to kill them.
